summary: Changed sync_deleted_response_xml to emit HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found (was 207 Multi-Status) for deleted resources per RFC 6578, updated the doc comment, and fixed the test assertion that asserted the wrong status.
important_context: Deleted-resource sync-collection responses now use 404 Not Found as a direct child of D:response, consistent with the multiget 404 handling at http.rs:1462.
